Answer all questions.  For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the multiple choice answer sheet.  Follow the instructions on the multiple choice answer sheet.  Write in soft pencil.  Write your name, centre number and candidate number on the multiple choice answer sheet in the spaces provided unless this has been done for you.  Do not use correction fluid.  Do not write on any bar codes.  You may use a calculator. questions.questionText: A stone is thrown horizontally off a cliff and then lands in the sea. Air resistance is negligible. Which statement about the stone’s motion is not correct?

options.A: The final displacement of the stone depends upon its initial horizontal velocity.
options.B: The stone travels with a constant horizontal component of velocity until it hits the water.
options.C: The stone travels with an increasing vertical component of velocity.
options.D: The time taken for the stone to hit the surface of the water depends on its initial horizontal velocity.

Two forces act as a couple. Which statement about the two forces must not be correct?

options.A: They act along the same straight line.
options.C: They are the same type of force.
